ctbids-48620-5663831.description:
Featured in this lot is a selection of fine vintage silver drinkware centered around a solid sterling silver cup by International Sterling. Stamped "Sterling K95" on the bottom, the cup measures 3" in diameter by 2.5" tall and exhibits minor surface dents consistent with age and use.
-Accompanying the sterling cup is a matching set of 11 vintage silver-plated goblets marked "International Silver Company" on the base.
-Each goblet measures 3" in diameter by 6" tall, offering a classic aesthetic for dining or collection.
- Formed in Meriden, Connecticut in 1898, ISC brought together many independent historical silver manufacturers under one massive corporate umbrella.
-They became a dominant force in mid-century American tableware and produced these specific plain-walled, smooth-stemmed goblet styles in large numbers during the 1960s, 1970s, and 1980s.
-Note: Winning bidder should bring boxes and packing for your treasures!
*** Estimated Secondary Market Values:
-International Silver Co. Silver-Plated Goblets (Set of 11): $120 - $180
-International Sterling Silver Cup (K95): $35 - $60 (based on silver melt value and condition)
***Total Estimated Value for Lot 1: $155 - $240
-Items Show Wear & Tear Consistent With Age - Items Are Sold As Is - Untested Unless Stated Otherwise- Manufacturers Are Not Verified or Authenticated - We Show What We Find As The Maker's Mark.

279187826.description:
This lot includes various blank VHS video tapes from TDK and RCA. It contains nine TDK HS Premium Quality VHS tapes, each with a 120-minute recording time, sealed in red packaging. Also included is one RCA T-120 Hi-Fi Stereo Video Tape in its original black and purple box, one TDK E-HG Ultimate Performance Extra High Grade VHS tape (T-120, 6 hours EP), and one TDK S-HG Super High Grade VHS tape in a gold and gray box. All tapes appear to be new and factory sealed with packaging intact and no visible signs of wear.
A Note About Untested Cameras:
We want to be transparent about what we know and what we don't. Unless otherwise stated above, cameras have not been tested, and any included batteries, chargers, or accessories are also untested. Since all of our merchandise is donated, the condition of these components is unknown, and we cannot assume they are functional. Rather than speculate about a camera's operation, we prefer to describe it as untested and let the photos speak for its visible condition. Please review the listing carefully and bid accordingly.
